act_name: Supreme Court (Review of Judgments and Orders) Act, 2023
heading: Short title, commencement and extent
title: Short title, commencement and extent
text:
1.
Short title, commencement and extent.__ (1) This Act shall be called the Supreme Court (Review of Judgments and Orders) Act, 2023.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

act_name: Supreme Court (Review of Judgments and Orders) Act, 2023
heading: Enlargement of jurisdiction of the Supreme Court
title: Enlargement of jurisdiction of the Supreme Court
text:
2.
Enlargement of jurisdiction of the Supreme Court.— In case of judgments and orders of the Supreme Court in exercise of its original jurisdiction under Article 184 of the Constitution, the scope of review on both facts and law, shall be the same as an appeal under Article 185 of the Constitution.
raw_text:
2. 
Enlargement of jurisdiction of the Supreme Court.— In case of judgments and 
orders of the Supreme Court in exercise of its original jurisdiction under Article 184 of the 
Constitution, the scope of review on both facts and law, shall be the same as an appeal under Article 
185 of the Constitution.

act_name: Supreme Court (Review of Judgments and Orders) Act, 2023
heading: Larger Bench
title: Larger Bench
text:
3.
Larger Bench.— A review petition shall be heard by a Bench larger than the Bench which passed the original judgment or order.

act_name: Supreme Court (Review of Judgments and Orders) Act, 2023
heading: Right to appoint counsel
title: Right to appoint counsel
text:
4.
Right to appoint counsel.__ The review petitioner shall have the right to appoint any advocate of the Supreme Court of his choice for the review petition.

act_name: Supreme Court (Review of Judgments and Orders) Act, 2023
heading: Judgments and orders made prior to commencement of this Act
title: Judgments and orders made prior to commencement of this Act
text:
5.
Judgments and orders made prior to commencement of this Act.— The right to file a review petition shall also be available to an aggrieved person against whom an order has been made under-clause (3) of Article 184 of the Constitution, prior to the commencement of this Act:
Provided that the review petition under this section shall be filed within sixty days of the commencement of this Act.

act_name: Supreme Court (Review of Judgments and Orders) Act, 2023
heading: Limitation
title: Limitation
text:
6.
Limitation.__ A review petition may be filed within sixty days of the passing of the original order.

act_name: Supreme Court (Review of Judgments and Orders) Act, 2023
heading: Act to override other laws etc
title: Act to override other laws etc
text:
7.
Act to override other laws etc.— The provisions of this Act shall have effect notwithstanding anything contained in any other law, rules or regulations for the time being in force or judgment of any court including the Supreme Court and a High Court.
